description: Module Tier Manifest — see PLATFORM_ARCHITECTURE.md § 6.2. Tier A requires full Clean Architecture. Tier B requires controller/service/dto/tests.

A.description: Full four-layer Clean Architecture. max-lines: 400 controller / 800 service. Domain layer has zero framework imports. 100% coverage on calculation paths.

B.description: Controller / service / dto / tests. max-lines enforced. Promote to Tier A when module exceeds 15 KLoc or acquires money.
